sections.description: Royal BatchMate is a complete community, membership directory, reunion, and event management platform for WordPress. Built for SSC, HSC, and University alumni batches.
sections.changelog:
• 26.11.23: Added dedicated Buffer Direct Connections (GraphQL API) inside Webhook Connections (Multi-Webhook) with API Key, Fetch Channels, multi-channel rows with Facebook/Instagram metadata support, Send Test Buffer Post, and simultaneous dispatch alongside Make.com; moved Customize Front-End Labels and Form Fields & Labels Configuration into a new Labels & Fields tab; fixed stray closing div/form tags that broke settings width, leaked registration fields across tabs, and prevented multi-row automation fields from saving.
  • 26.11.22: Fixed existing member auto-sync (name, district, photo, and profile fields) on event approval, filtered DB payloads against existing columns, cleared/ignored literal 'null' districts in tables and summaries, fixed migration column order, and applied dynamic Settings field labels (e.g. Name (English)) across the event registration form and validation alerts.
  • 26.11.21: Added side-by-side Payment Method Summary & Saree count/print in Event Registered Members, prioritized permanent district in tables/summaries, fixed print table alignment & footer orgLabel, fixed missing AJAX handler requires & desktop table scrollbar, and modularized admin-events.js, shortcode-event-form.php, admin-members-list-page.php, and single-member.php into separate cached CSS/JS assets.
  • 26.11.20: Readonly submit button showing   • 26.11.19: Fixed missing LEFT JOIN on batchmate_program table across member login shortcode, member profile, application list AJAX, and print templates. Fixed GROUP BY query syntax in admin programs AJAX.
  • 26.11.18: Fixed frontend event form render issue caused by unexpected closing brace syntax error.
  • 26.11.17: Fixed 'Failed to save non-member information' root cause (varchar column overflow on long event names). Enqueued Select2 and SweetAlert2 on frontend for Elementor event forms. Added required field validation popup with red highlights, smooth auto-focus, and preserved form data on error.
  • 26.11.16: Auto-migration guard for missing database columns in rawdata and application tables.
  • 26.11.15: Fixed Guest Options (Family/Guest fees) not showing on Direct Form (Option 4). Removed duplicate Labels card from Registration Settings.
  • 26.11.14: English labels for event registration modal, auto-updater UTF-8 BOM resilience, and cache busting fixes.
  • 26.11.13: Added Option 4 (Direct Form Only) to Edit Event modal to bypass profile search.
  • 26.11.12: Fixed activation 3 characters unexpected output (UTF-8 BOM removal). Fixed Event CC Email delivery.
  • 26.11.11: Added dedicated Elementor Event Form Widget with live style customization.
